title: Simple harmonic oscillator
tagline: One block, one spring and the prettiest ellipse in phase space.

block.title: Block
block.desc: It has mass m: its inertia. The more mass, the harder it is to accelerate (F = m ẍ) and the slower it oscillates.

spring.title: Spring
spring.desc: Pulls or pushes in proportion to how much you stretch or compress it, F = −k x. Stiffer (larger k) → faster oscillation.

wall.title: Wall
wall.desc: Fixed point the spring is anchored to. It never moves: it is the reference for the motion.

velocity.title: Velocity
velocity.desc: The arrow shows the velocity v. While paused, drag its tip to choose the initial velocity v₀.
